title: Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd - proposed acquisition of sub-custodian business from Westpac Banking Corporation and Westpac Custodian Nominees Ltd
acquirers: Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd
targets: Westpac Banking Corporation and Westpac Custodian Nominees Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced that it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd (HSBC) acquired sub-custodial assets from Westpac Custodian Nominees (WCN) (HSBC's acquisition).
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered HSBC's acquisition in the context of a national market for domestic custodial services, which includes sub-custodial services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that HSBC faced sufficient competitive constraints post-acquisition and that the acquisition is unlikely to have caused a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. This conclusion was informed by the following factors: - there are a number of substitutes available to customers for domestic custodial services in Australia; - the acquisition resulted in a small change in market concentration levels in the national market for domestic custodial services; and - customers for domestic custodial services possess countervailing power when negotiating the terms of a contract for the provision of domestic custodial services.
